overview: This one-page file consists solely of a list-of-papers index for the State Department subject file on Japanese geology. It records a December 23 item concerning a book entitled “Geology of the Environs of Tokyo,” noting its transmission to the Secretary of State; the indexed document itself is not present in the surviving OCR text.

subfiles.title: List of Papers for Geology—Japan
subfiles.about: The index records a December 23 item concerning the transmission of a book entitled “Geology of the Environs of Tokyo.”
subfiles.summary: This filing sheet identifies the subject as “Geology—Japan” under decimal number 894.924. Its sole entry, dated December 23 without a stated year, concerns a book entitled “Geology of the Environs of Tokyo.” The entry lists E. Walker in the “TO” column and indicates, in partially garbled OCR, that the book was transmitted to the Secretary of State.
keywords: Geology of the Environs of Tokyo

interest: The sheet is useful primarily as evidence of a now-absent document and of the State Department’s collection or circulation of scientific literature about Japan. It identifies a specific geological work on the Tokyo region and preserves a fragment of its administrative transmission history, although the sender, year, and precise wording of the transaction are missing or obscured.
